data.content:
However, manager Mark van Bommel still faces notable injury concerns in attack and defence. Star striker Romelu Lukaku remains a major doubt after sitting out the midweek fixture with a hip issue, while forward Loïs Openda and defender Zeno Debast have also been managing fitness setbacks during this international window.

Additionally, goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois remains unavailable as he continues his planned break from international duty until the Euro 2028 qualifiers.

Advertisement [...] ## Italy

Italy arrive in Brussels riding a four-match unbeaten streak (3W-1D-1L overall) in Group A1. Following an opening 2–0 home loss to Belgium, Roberto Mancini's side rebounded with dominant victories over Türkiye (4–1 away, 3–1 home) and a 1–1 draw in France. On Thursday, the Azzurri produced their best performance of the campaign, fighting back from a goal down to defeat France 3–1 in Milan and claim top spot.

## Predicted lineups [...] Head coach Roberto Mancini must also navigate defensive disruptions, as Arsenal's Riccardo Calafiori is a fitness doubt. These setbacks add to a string of earlier withdrawals, with Gianluca Mancini, Giovanni Di Lorenzo, Moise Kean, and Matteo Ruggeri all sidelined through injury, alongside Nicolò Zaniolo, who left the squad earlier for personal reasons.
